title: Mountain Wind Across Alpine Meadow
description: Recorded at 2,800m on the Grossglockner High Alpine Road in Austria. Wind across short alpine grass, distant cowbells, occasional raptor calls. Perfect for focus and open-air work.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Mountain Wind Across Alpine Meadow — Field Recording Austria
seo.description: Authentic field recording of wind across an alpine meadow at 2,800m in the Austrian Alps.

title: Forest Dawn Chorus
description: Temperate rainforest in the Hoh Valley, Olympic Peninsula, at first light in May. Over forty distinct bird species documented in this single one-hour recording.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Forest Dawn Chorus — Olympic Peninsula Field Recording
seo.description: Over forty bird species recorded at dawn in the Hoh Valley temperate rainforest.

title: Rain on Window at Night
description: Steady autumn rain on a single-pane glass window in Edinburgh. Recorded at midnight with a contact microphone. The patter is completely uniform — no wind, no thunder, just rain.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Rain on Window at Night — Edinburgh Rain Ambient Sound
seo.description: Steady autumn rain on a window pane, recorded at midnight in Edinburgh. Pure rain ambience for sleep and focus.

title: Cinematic Piano Evening
description: Solo Bösendorfer piano, recorded in a stone chapel in Burgundy. Sparse, unhurried — each note has air around it. Composed for the transition hour between day and night.
creator: cr-003

seo.title: Cinematic Piano Evening — Solo Piano Ambient Music
seo.description: Sparse cinematic solo piano recorded in a Burgundy stone chapel. Contemplative evening music.

title: Gentle Ocean Waves
description: Long-period Atlantic swells rolling in to a wide sand beach in the Azores. No wind, no seabirds — only the rhythm of water that has crossed three thousand miles of open ocean.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Gentle Ocean Waves — Azores Atlantic Shore Field Recording
seo.description: Long-period Atlantic swells on an Azores sand beach. Pure ocean wave ambience for relaxation.

title: Deep Forest Interior
description: The acoustic interior of a 600-year-old Sitka spruce stand in the Quinault rainforest. Wind in the canopy 60 metres up. Almost no other sounds reach the forest floor.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Deep Forest Interior — Quinault Rainforest Field Recording
seo.description: Acoustic interior of ancient Sitka spruce forest in the Quinault rainforest.

title: City Café Ambience
description: A Parisian café on a Tuesday afternoon: espresso machine cycles, low conversation, occasional chair movement, and the distant sound of a boulevard through a half-open door.
creator: cr-006

seo.title: City Café Ambience — Parisian Café Ambient Sound
seo.description: Authentic Parisian café ambience with espresso machine, conversation, and street sounds.

title: Orchestral Mountain Theme
description: A full orchestral piece written for a mountain documentary — three movements across six minutes. Strings carry the base, brass arrive with the summit, then everything falls away at descent.
creator: cr-003

seo.title: Orchestral Mountain Theme — Cinematic Documentary Music
seo.description: Three-movement orchestral piece for mountain documentary. Epic cinematic soundtrack music.

title: Bamboo Grove in the Breeze
description: Hollow bamboo stalks click and creak against each other in a light wind in Arashiyama. The sound is percussive and rhythmic — almost musical — recorded at the same grove as the photograph.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Bamboo Grove in the Breeze — Arashiyama Field Recording
seo.description: Bamboo stalks in a light wind at Arashiyama, Kyoto. Rhythmic natural ambient sound.

title: Distant Thunderstorm
description: A cell storms over the Appalachian ridge at 25 miles distance. Rolling thunder comes in waves, each overlapping the last. Recorded outdoors with no rain on the microphone.
creator: cr-007

seo.title: Distant Thunderstorm — Appalachian Thunder Field Recording
seo.description: Rolling thunder from a distant storm over the Appalachian ridge. Dramatic weather sound recording.

title: Lo-Fi Study Session

creator: cr-006

seo.title: Lo-Fi Study Session — Chill Beats for Focus
seo.description: Warm lo-fi hip-hop loop at 75bpm with vinyl crackle and Rhodes chords. Perfect for study and focus.

title: Ambient Space Drift

creator: cr-003

seo.title: Ambient Space Drift — Generative Synthesizer Music
seo.description: Twelve minutes of slowly evolving synthesizer pads. Long-form generative ambient music.
